content.short: Team Finance is a token management solution for creating, vesting, locking, and tracking tokens.
content.description: Team Finance serves as a comprehensive toolkit for token management, spanning the end-to-end token lifecycle—from token creation to vesting automation, locking, and tracking, and including automation of contributor payments. It provides the controls and automation needed to manage token issuance, vesting schedules, and secure lockups, while delivering clear visibility into token activity and flow. The goal is to help any company build in Web3 by supplying the essential tooling required to launch, manage, and grow a tokenized project.
